name: io.github.vora-ai/voice
title: Vora Voice -- Voice for Autonomous AI Agents
description: Make phone calls, close deals, book meetings. Full-stack voice AI with conversational onboarding, persistent voice agents, and self-improving call performance. 30+ languages including Arabic, Hindi, Vietnamese.
